ko.R: 예수께서 다가가셔서 죽은 사람을 눕혀 메고 가던 들것에 손을 대셨다. 그러자 메고 가던 사람들이 걸음을 멈추었다. 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "청년아, 내가 너에게 말한다. 일어나라!"

pt.L: E, aproximando-se, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tocou a padiola, e os que [a] carregavam pararam, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse: "Jovem, a você eu digo: levante-se."
pt.B: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se aproximou e tocou a padiola, e os homens que a carregavam pararam. Ele disse: "Jovem, eu lhe digo: levante-se!"
pt.R: Então Jesus se aproximou e tocou na padiola em que levavam o corpo. Os homens que a carregavam pararam. Jesus disse: "Moço, eu digo a você: levante-se!"

am.L: ቀርቦም ቃሬዛውን ዳሰሰ፤ የተሸከሙትም ቆሙ፤ እንዲህም አለ፦ «ወጣት ሆይ፣ እልሃለሁ፣ ተነሥ።»
am.B: ከዚያም ቀርቦ ቃሬዛውን ነካ፤ የተሸከሙትም ሰዎች ቆሙ። እርሱም «ወጣት ሆይ፣ እልሃለሁ፣ ተነሥ!» አለ።
am.R: ከዚያም ኢየሱስ ቀርቦ አስከሬኑን የተሸከሙበትን አልጋ ነካ። የተሸከሙት ሰዎችም ቆሙ። ኢየሱስም «አንተ ወጣት፣ እልሃለሁ፣ ተነሥ!» አለ።

decisions.choice: bier: the open frame or stretcher on which the body was carried
decisions.reason: Jewish burials did not use closed coffins; the body, wrapped in cloth, lay on an open bier. Touching it would make a person unclean under the law (Numbers 19:11-16), but Jesus's touch brings life.

decisions.choice: arise: get up, be raised
decisions.reason: The verb is used of getting up and of being raised from the dead (7:22; 9:22).

decisions.choice: to you I say: Jesus commands by his own authority
decisions.reason: Elijah and Elisha prayed to the LORD before the dead were raised (1 Kings 17:20-21; 2 Kings 4:33). Jesus speaks directly to the dead man.

decisions.choice: the frame they were carrying the body on
decisions.reason: "Bier" is a rare word, and "coffin" would be wrong.

decisions.choice: las andas
decisions.reason: The dead were carried on an open frame (meaning decision m1). "Féretro" and "ataúd" are closed coffins; "andas" is the open carrying frame. Readable describes it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: la civière (L, B); le brancard sur lequel on portait le corps (R)
decisions.reason: The body lay on an open frame (m1). "Cercueil" and "bière" are closed coffins, which would be wrong. "Civière" is the usual word for a stretcher carried by hand; Readable describes it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: machela
decisions.reason: The dead were carried on an open frame (meaning decision m1). "Jeneza" is now mostly a closed coffin; "machela" is a carrying frame. Readable describes it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "cái cáng" for the bier
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says an open frame or stretcher; "quan tài" is a closed coffin, which would not let the young man sit up.

decisions.choice: "anh" for the young man; "trỗi dậy" (L), "đứng dậy" (B, R) for "arise"
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to a grown young man with the ordinary respectful "anh". Literal keeps the solemn "trỗi dậy", which suits rising from death; Balanced and Readable use the plain command, as the English "get up".

decisions.choice: "상여" (L, B); "죽은 사람을 눕혀 메고 가던 들것" (R)
decisions.reason: The body lay on an open frame carried by bearers (meaning decision); "관" (coffin) would hide it from sight, while "상여" is the Korean frame for carrying the dead. Readable describes it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: a padiola
decisions.reason: The body lay on an open frame (m1). "Caixão" and "esquife" mean a closed coffin in Brazil, which would be wrong; "maca" suggests a hospital stretcher. "Padiola", a frame carried by bearers, fits, and Readable adds what it was for.

decisions.choice: "ቃሬዛ" (bier, a stretcher for the dead)
decisions.reason: The body lay on an open frame, not in a closed coffin; "ቃሬዛ" is the Amharic word for that frame. Readable describes it, as the English Readable does.

source.text: καὶ ἀνεκάθισεν ὁ νεκρὸς καὶ ἤρξατο λαλεῖν, καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὸν τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And sat up the dead [man] and began to speak, and he gave him to the mother of him.

en.L: And the dead man sat up and began to speak, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave him to his mother.
en.B: The dead man sat up and began to talk, and Jesus gave him back to his mother.
en.R: The dead man sat up and began to talk! And Jesus gave him back to his mother.

es.L: Y el muerto se incorporó y comenzó a hablar, y se lo dio a su madre.
es.B: El muerto se incorporó y comenzó a hablar, y Jesús se lo devolvió a su madre.
es.R: ¡El muerto se sentó y empezó a hablar! Y Jesús se lo devolvió a su madre.

fr.L: Et le mort se redressa et commença à parler, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le donna à sa mère.
fr.B: Le mort se redressa et se mit à parler, et Jésus le rendit à sa mère.
fr.R: Le mort s’est assis et il a commencé à parler ! Et Jésus l’a rendu à sa mère.

sw.L: Na yule mfu akaketi, akaanza kusema, naye akampa mama yake.
sw.B: Yule aliyekuwa amekufa aliketi, akaanza kuzungumza, na Yesu akamrudisha kwa mama yake.
sw.R: Yule aliyekufa aliketi, akaanza kuongea! Naye Yesu akamrudisha kwa mama yake.

vi.L: Và người chết ngồi dậy và bắt đầu nói, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trao anh cho mẹ anh.
vi.B: Người chết ngồi dậy và bắt đầu nói, và Đức Giê-xu trao anh lại cho mẹ anh.
vi.R: Người chết ngồi dậy và bắt đầu nói chuyện! Rồi Đức Giê-xu trao anh lại cho mẹ anh.

ko.L: 그러자 죽은 사람이 일어나 앉아서 말하기 시작했다. 그리고 그분이 그를 그의 어머니에게 주셨다.
ko.B: 그러자 죽었던 사람이 일어나 앉아서 말을 하기 시작했다. 예수께서 그를 어머니에게 돌려주셨다.
ko.R: 그러자 죽었던 청년이 일어나 앉아서 말을 하기 시작했다! 예수께서는 그를 어머니에게 돌려주셨다.

pt.L: E o morto se sentou e começou a falar, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o entregou à sua mãe.
pt.B: O morto se sentou e começou a falar, e Jesus o devolveu à sua mãe.
pt.R: O morto se sentou e começou a falar! E Jesus o devolveu à mãe dele.

am.L: የሞተውም ቀና ብሎ ተቀመጠ፤ መናገርም ጀመረ፤ ለእናቱም ሰጣት።
am.B: የሞተውም ሰው ቀና ብሎ ተቀመጠ፤ መናገርም ጀመረ። ኢየሱስም ለእናቱ መለሰላት።
am.R: የሞተው ሰው ቀና ብሎ ተቀመጠ፤ መናገርም ጀመረ! ኢየሱስም ልጁን ለእናቱ መለሰላት።

decisions.choice: he gave him to his mother: the words of 1 Kings 17:23
decisions.reason: The Greek Old Testament uses the same words of Elijah, who gave the widow's son back to his mother. The people's response in 7:16 names Jesus a great prophet.

decisions.choice: began to speak: proof that he was truly alive
decisions.reason: Luke does not tell what he said; his speaking shows that life has returned.

decisions.choice: Jesus gave him back
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jesus, since several men have been mentioned, and say "back" because she had lost him.

source.text: ἔλαβεν δὲ φόβος πάντας, καὶ ἐδόξαζον τὸν θεὸν λέγοντες ὅτι Προφήτης μέγας ἠγέρθη ἐν ἡμῖν, καὶ ὅτι Ἐπεσκέψατο ὁ θεὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Seized then fear all, and they were glorifying the God saying that, A prophet great has been raised among us, and that, Has visited the God the people of him.

en.L: And fear seized [them] all, and they were glorifying God, saying, "A great prophet has been raised up among us," and, "God has visited {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people!"
en.B: Awe took hold of everyone, and they gave glory to God. "A great prophet has appeared among us!" they said, and, "God has come to help {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people!"
en.R: Everyone there was filled with fear and wonder, and they gave glory to God. They said, "A great prophet has come to us!" They also said, "God has come to help {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people!"

es.L: Y el temor se apoderó de todos, y glorificaban a Dios, diciendo: «Un gran profeta se ha levantado entre nosotros», y: «¡Dios ha visitado a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo!».
es.B: Todos quedaron sobrecogidos de temor, y daban gloria a Dios. Decían: «¡Un gran profeta ha aparecido entre nosotros!», y también: «¡Dios ha venido a ayudar a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo!».
es.R: Todos los que estaban allí se llenaron de temor y asombro, y daban gloria a Dios. Decían: «¡Un gran profeta ha venido a nosotros!». También decían: «¡Dios ha venido a ayudar a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo!».

fr.L: Et la crainte s’empara de tous, et ils glorifiaient Dieu, disant : « Un grand prophète a été suscité parmi nous », et : « Dieu a visité {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple ! »
fr.B: Une crainte pleine de respect s’empara de tous, et ils rendaient gloire à Dieu. « Un grand prophète est apparu parmi nous ! » disaient-ils, et : « Dieu est venu au secours de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple ! »
fr.R: Tous ceux qui étaient là ont été remplis de crainte et d’émerveillement, et ils ont rendu gloire à Dieu. Ils ont dit : « Un grand prophète est venu parmi nous ! » Ils ont dit aussi : « Dieu est venu au secours de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple ! »

sw.L: Hofu ikawashika wote, nao wakawa wakimtukuza Mungu, wakisema, "Nabii mkuu ameinuliwa kati yetu," na, "Mungu amewatembelea watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}!"
sw.B: Wote walijawa na hofu kuu, wakamtukuza Mungu, wakisema, "Nabii mkuu ametokea kati yetu!" na, "Mungu amekuja kuwasaidia watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}!"
sw.R: Kila mtu aliyekuwepo alijawa na hofu na mshangao, nao wakamtukuza Mungu. Wakasema, "Nabii mkuu amekuja kwetu!" Wakasema pia, "Mungu amekuja kuwasaidia watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}!"

vi.L: Và sự sợ hãi chiếm lấy mọi người, và họ tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời, nói rằng: "Một nhà tiên tri lớn đã dấy lên giữa chúng ta," và: "Đức Chúa Trời đã thăm viếng dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!"
vi.B: Mọi người đều kính sợ, và họ tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời. Họ nói: "Một nhà tiên tri lớn đã xuất hiện giữa chúng ta!" và: "Đức Chúa Trời đã đến cứu giúp dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!"
vi.R: Mọi người ở đó vừa sợ hãi vừa kinh ngạc, và họ ngợi khen Đức Chúa Trời. Họ nói: "Một nhà tiên tri lớn đã đến với chúng ta!" Họ cũng nói: "Đức Chúa Trời đã đến cứu giúp dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!"

ko.L: 그러자 두려움이 모든 사람을 사로잡았고, 그들은 하나님께 영광을 돌리며 말했다. "큰 예언자가 우리 가운데 일어났다." 그리고 "하나님께서 그분의 백성을 돌아보셨다."
ko.B: 모든 사람이 경외감에 사로잡혀 하나님께 영광을 돌렸다. 그들은 "큰 예언자가 우리 가운데 나타났다!" 하고, 또 "하나님께서 자기 백성을 도우러 오셨다!" 하고 말했다.
ko.R: 그곳에 있던 사람들은 모두 두렵기도 하고 놀랍기도 했다. 그들은 하나님을 찬양하며 말했다. "위대한 예언자가 우리에게 나타났다!" 또 이렇게 말했다. "하나님께서 자기 백성을 도우러 오셨다!"

pt.L: E o temor se apoderou de todos, e glorificavam a Deus, dizendo: "Um grande profeta se levantou entre nós", e: "Deus visitou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo!"
pt.B: Todos ficaram tomados de temor e davam glória a Deus. "Um grande profeta apareceu entre nós!", diziam; e: "Deus veio socorrer o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo!"
pt.R: Todos os que estavam ali ficaram cheios de medo e admiração, e deram glória a Deus. Eles diziam: "Um grande profeta veio até nós!" E diziam também: "Deus veio ajudar o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo!"

am.L: ፍርሃትም ሁሉንም ያዛቸው፤ እግዚአብሔርንም እያከበሩ «ታላቅ ነቢይ በመካከላችን ተነሥቷል» ደግሞም «እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ጎብኝቷል!» ይሉ ነበር።
am.B: ሁሉም በፍርሃትና በአክብሮት ተሞሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም አከበሩ። «ታላቅ ነቢይ በመካከላችን ተገልጧል!» አሉ፤ ደግሞም «እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ሊረዳ መጥቷል!» አሉ።
am.R: በዚያ የነበሩት ሁሉ በፍርሃትና በአድናቆት ተሞሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም አከበሩ። እንዲህም አሉ፦ «ታላቅ ነቢይ ወደ እኛ መጥቷል!» ደግሞም «እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ሊረዳ መጥቷል!» አሉ።

decisions.choice: fear: awe before God's power
decisions.reason: As in 5:26, people are filled with fear when God acts among them.

decisions.choice: glorifying God: praising God for what he has done
decisions.reason: People in Luke give glory to God when they see his work (2:20; 5:25-26).

decisions.choice: has been raised up: God has sent a prophet
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in 7:14, but here it means that God has caused a prophet to appear, as Moses promised (Deuteronomy 18:15).

decisions.choice: visited: came to help
decisions.reason: As in 1:68 and 1:78, God visits his people when he comes to act for them (Exodus 4:31; Ruth 1:6).

decisions.choice: gave glory to God
decisions.reason: The verb is the one for glory; Balanced and Readable keep that word, as in 5:25.

decisions.choice: has come to help his people
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of "visited", as in 1:68.

decisions.choice: awe (B); fear and wonder (R)
decisions.reason: As in 5:26, "fear" alone would suggest terror.

decisions.choice: une crainte pleine de respect (B); la crainte et l’émerveillement (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: the fear is awe before God's power (m1). "La peur" would say terror; Literal keeps "la crainte", and Balanced and Readable say what kind of fear it was.

decisions.choice: "sự sợ hãi" (L); "kính sợ" (B); "vừa sợ hãi vừa kinh ngạc" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Luke 5:26: the meaning decision says awe before God's power; "kính sợ" is fear with reverence, and Readable names both feelings.

decisions.choice: "thăm viếng" (L); "đến cứu giúp" (B, R) for "visited"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says came to help; Literal keeps the Bible's word, which in plain Vietnamese means only a social call, and Balanced and Readable say what it means. "tôn vinh" (L, B) and "ngợi khen" (R) as in 5:25-26.

decisions.choice: "두려움" (L), "경외감" (B), "두렵기도 하고 놀랍기도" (R); "하나님께 영광을 돌리다" (L, B), "하나님을 찬양하다" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Luke 5:25-26 in Korean: the fear is awe before God's power (meaning decision), and Readable uses the everyday word for praising God.

decisions.choice: "돌아보셨다" (L); "도우러 오셨다" (B, R) for episkeptomai
decisions.reason: God's visiting means coming to help (meaning decision); "방문하다" would be a social call. Literal keeps the old sense of looking after his people with "돌아보다", as Luke 1:48 does in Korean.

decisions.choice: "ጎብኝቷል" (has visited) at Literal
decisions.reason: "ጎበኘ" has the Greek picture of a visit; Balanced and Readable say what the visit means, coming to help, as the English does.

source.text: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ λόγος οὗτος ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ περὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ πάσῃ τῇ περιχώρῳ.

records.literal_gloss: And went out the report this in all the Judea concerning him and all the surrounding region.

en.L: And this report about {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} went out in all Judea and all the surrounding region.
en.B: This news about {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} spread through all Judea and the whole region around it.
en.R: The news about what Jesus had done spread everywhere in the land of the Jews and in all the places around it.

es.L: Y salió esta noticia acerca de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} por toda Judea y por toda la región de alrededor.
es.B: Esta noticia acerca de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se extendió por toda Judea y por toda la región vecina.
es.R: La noticia de lo que Jesús había hecho se extendió por toda la tierra de los judíos y por todos los lugares de alrededor.

fr.L: Et cette nouvelle à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sujet se répandit dans toute la Judée et dans toute la région d’alentour.
fr.B: Ce qu’on disait de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} se répandit dans toute la Judée et dans toute la région voisine.
fr.R: La nouvelle de ce que Jésus avait fait s’est répandue partout dans le pays des Juifs et dans toutes les régions autour.

sw.L: Na neno hili kumhusu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} likaenea katika Uyahudi wote na katika nchi yote ya kandokando.
sw.B: Habari hizi kumhusu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} zilienea katika Uyahudi wote na katika eneo lote lililouzunguka.
sw.R: Habari za mambo ambayo Yesu alikuwa amefanya zilienea kila mahali katika nchi ya Wayahudi na katika maeneo yote yaliyoizunguka.

vi.L: Và lời đồn này về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lan ra khắp cả Giu-đê và khắp vùng chung quanh.
vi.B: Tin này về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lan ra khắp xứ Giu-đê và cả vùng lân cận.
vi.R: Tin về việc Đức Giê-xu đã làm lan ra khắp xứ của người Do Thái và khắp các vùng chung quanh.

ko.L: 그리고 그분에 대한 이 말이 온 유대와 모든 주변 지역에 퍼져 나갔다.
ko.B: 예수에 대한 이 소문이 온 유대와 그 주변 모든 지역에 두루 퍼졌다.
ko.R: 예수께서 하신 일에 대한 소식이 유대 사람들이 사는 온 땅과 그 주변의 모든 곳에 퍼졌다.

pt.L: E esta notícia a respeito {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} se espalhou por toda a Judeia e por toda a região ao redor.
pt.B: Essa notícia sobre {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se espalhou por toda a Judeia e por toda a região em volta.
pt.R: A notícia do que Jesus tinha feito se espalhou por toda a terra dos judeus e por todos os lugares em volta.

am.L: ይህም ስለ እርሱ የተነገረው ወሬ በይሁዳ ሁሉና በዙሪያው ባለው አገር ሁሉ ወጣ።
am.B: ስለ እርሱ የተሰማው ይህ ወሬ በመላው ይሁዳና በዙሪያው ባለው አካባቢ ሁሉ ተሰራጨ።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ስላደረገው ነገር የሚነገረው ወሬ በአይሁድ አገር ሁሉና በዙሪያው ባሉ ስፍራዎች ሁሉ ተዳረሰ።

decisions.choice: Judea: the whole land of the Jews
alternatives: only the southern region around Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Nain is in Galilee, so Judea here means the land where the Jews lived, as in 1:5 and 4:44.

decisions.choice: report: the word that was told about him
decisions.reason: The noun is the usual word for word or message; here it is the news that spread by word of mouth.

decisions.choice: the land of the Jews
decisions.reason: Readable explains the broad sense of Judea, as the meaning decision says.

decisions.choice: what Jesus had done
decisions.reason: Readable says what the news was about.

decisions.choice: "Giu-đê" (L, B); "xứ của người Do Thái" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the whole land of the Jews, not only the province of Judea, so Readable says that, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "유대 사람들이 사는 온 땅" (R) for Judea
decisions.reason: Judea here is the whole land of the Jews (meaning decision), which Readable says plainly, as the English Readable does.

source.text: Καὶ ἀπήγγειλαν Ἰωάννῃ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ περὶ πάντων τούτων.

records.literal_gloss: And reported to John the disciples of him concerning all these things.

en.L: And John's disciples reported to him about all these things.
en.B: John's disciples told him about all these things.
en.R: John's followers told him about everything Jesus was doing.

es.L: Y le informaron a Juan sus discípulos acerca de todas estas cosas.
es.B: Los discípulos de Juan le contaron todas estas cosas.
es.R: Los discípulos de Juan le contaron todo lo que Jesús estaba haciendo.

fr.L: Et les disciples de Jean lui rapportèrent toutes ces choses.
fr.B: Les disciples de Jean lui racontèrent tout cela.
fr.R: Les disciples de Jean lui ont raconté tout ce que Jésus faisait.

sw.L: Na wanafunzi wake wakamweleza Yohana habari za mambo haya yote.
sw.B: Wanafunzi wa Yohana walimweleza mambo hayo yote.
sw.R: Wanafunzi wa Yohana walimweleza kila kitu ambacho Yesu alikuwa akifanya.

vi.L: Và các môn đồ của Giăng báo cho ông biết về tất cả những việc ấy.
vi.B: Các môn đồ của Giăng kể cho ông nghe về mọi việc ấy.
vi.R: Các môn đồ của Giăng kể cho ông nghe về mọi việc Đức Giê-xu đang làm.

ko.L: 그리고 요한의 제자들이 이 모든 일에 대하여 그에게 알렸다.
ko.B: 요한의 제자들이 이 모든 일을 요한에게 알렸다.
ko.R: 요한의 제자들이 예수께서 하시는 모든 일을 요한에게 전했다.

pt.L: E os discípulos de João lhe contaram a respeito de todas essas coisas.
pt.B: Os discípulos de João contaram a ele tudo isso.
pt.R: Os seguidores de João contaram a ele tudo o que Jesus estava fazendo.

am.L: የዮሐንስም ደቀ መዛሙርት ስለዚህ ሁሉ ነገሩት።
am.B: የዮሐንስ ደቀ መዛሙርት ይህን ሁሉ ነገሩት።
am.R: የዮሐንስ ደቀ መዛሙርት ኢየሱስ የሚያደርገውን ሁሉ ነገሩት።

decisions.choice: John: John the Baptist, now in prison
decisions.reason: Herod had locked John up in prison (3:19-20). His disciples still visited him.

decisions.choice: all these things: Jesus's healings and teaching, including the raising at Nain
decisions.reason: The phrase sums up what Luke has told since John's arrest.

decisions.choice: followers
decisions.reason: Readable uses an everyday word for disciples here, since they were not Jesus's disciples.

decisions.choice: everything Jesus was doing
decisions.reason: Readable says what "these things" were.

decisions.choice: discípulos, at Readable too
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice: "discípulos" at every level, even where the English Readable says "followers", since the Spanish word is plain and well known. The same in verses 18-19.

decisions.choice: les disciples de Jean at Readable too
decisions.reason: English Readable says "followers" because "disciples" sounds like Jesus's Twelve. In French "disciple" is the ordinary word for the pupil of any teacher, and "de Jean" makes plain whose they were, so Readable keeps it, as Mark's Readable keeps "disciples".

decisions.choice: wanafunzi, at Readable too
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice: "wanafunzi" at every level, even where the English Readable says "followers", since the Swahili word is plain and well known. The same in verses 18-19.

decisions.choice: "môn đồ" at Readable too
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "followers"; the style guide keeps "môn đồ" at every level, as in Mark 2:18, where John's disciples are "các môn đồ của Giăng".

decisions.choice: "제자들" at every level, Readable included
decisions.reason: "제자" is kept at every level in the Gospels in Korean, for John's disciples as for Jesus's (Luke 5:33); Korean readers know it, and the English Readable's "followers" has no better Korean word.

decisions.choice: "ደቀ መዛሙርት" (disciples) at Readable too, where the English Readable says "followers"
decisions.reason: "ደቀ መዛሙርት" is the ordinary Amharic word for a teacher's disciples, known to every reader, so Readable keeps it, as in Matthew.

source.text: καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος δύο τινὰς τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ὁ Ἰωάννης ἔπεμψεν πρὸς τὸν κύριον λέγων· Σὺ εἶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἢ ἄλλον προσδοκῶμεν;

records.literal_gloss: And having called to [him] two certain of the disciples of him John \v 19 sent to the Lord saying, You are the coming [one] or another should we wait for?

en.L: And calling two of his disciples, John \v 19 sent [them] to the Lord, saying, "Are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} the one who is coming, or should we wait for another?"
en.B: So John called two of his disciples \v 19 and sent them to the Lord to ask, "Are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} the one who is to come, or are we to look for someone else?"
en.R: So John called two of his followers. \v 19 He sent them to the Lord Jesus to ask, "Are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} the one God promised would come? Or should we keep waiting for someone else?"

es.L: Y llamando a dos de sus discípulos, Juan \v 19 [los] envió al Señor, diciendo: «¿Eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} el que viene, o esperamos a otro?».
es.B: Entonces Juan llamó a dos de sus discípulos \v 19 y los envió al Señor a preguntarle: «¿Eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} el que había de venir, o debemos esperar a otro?».
es.R: Entonces Juan llamó a dos de sus discípulos. \v 19 Los envió al Señor Jesús a preguntarle: «¿Eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} aquel que Dios prometió que vendría? ¿O debemos seguir esperando a otro?».

fr.L: Et ayant appelé deux de ses disciples, Jean \v 19 [les] envoya vers le Seigneur pour dire : « Es-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} celui qui vient, ou devons-nous en attendre un autre ? »
fr.B: Jean appela donc deux de ses disciples \v 19 et les envoya demander au Seigneur : « Es-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} celui qui doit venir, ou devons-nous en attendre un autre ? »
fr.R: Alors Jean a appelé deux de ses disciples. \v 19 Il les a envoyés auprès du Seigneur Jésus pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demander : « Es-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} celui que Dieu a promis d’envoyer ? Ou devons-nous continuer à attendre quelqu’un d’autre ? »

sw.L: Na Yohana, akiwaita wawili kati ya wanafunzi wake, \v 19 aliwatuma kwa Bwana, akisema, "Je, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiye yule anayekuja, au tumngoje mwingine?"
sw.B: Basi Yohana aliwaita wanafunzi wake wawili, \v 19 akawatuma kwa Bwana wamwulize, "Je, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiye yule atakayekuja, au tumsubiri mtu mwingine?"
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Yohana aliwaita wanafunzi wake wawili. \v 19 Akawatuma kwa Bwana Yesu wamwulize, "Je, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiye yule ambaye Mungu aliahidi kwamba atakuja? Au tuendelee kumngoja mtu mwingine?"

vi.L: Và gọi hai người trong các môn đồ mình, Giăng \v 19 sai [họ] đến với Chúa, nói rằng: "Thầy có phải là Đấng phải đến không, hay chúng tôi phải đợi một người khác?"
vi.B: Vậy Giăng gọi hai môn đồ của mình \v 19 và sai họ đến hỏi Chúa: "Thầy có phải là Đấng phải đến không, hay chúng tôi còn phải trông đợi một người khác?"
vi.R: Vì vậy, Giăng gọi hai môn đồ của mình. \v 19 Ông sai họ đến hỏi Chúa Giê-xu: "Thầy có phải là Đấng mà Đức Chúa Trời đã hứa sẽ đến không? Hay chúng tôi phải tiếp tục chờ đợi một người khác?"

ko.L: 그러자 요한이 자기 제자들 가운데 두 사람을 불러 \v 19 주님께 보내며 말하게 하였다. "오실 분이 선생님이십니까, 아니면 저희가 다른 분을 기다려야 합니까?"
ko.B: 요한은 제자들 가운데 두 사람을 불러 \v 19 주님께 보내어 이렇게 여쭈어 보게 하였다. "오시기로 되어 있는 분이 선생님이십니까? 아니면 저희가 다른 분을 기다려야 합니까?"
ko.R: 그래서 요한은 제자 두 사람을 불렀다. \v 19 그리고 그들을 주 예수께 보내어 여쭈어 보게 하였다. "하나님께서 보내 주시겠다고 약속하신 분이 바로 선생님이십니까? 아니면 저희가 다른 분을 계속 기다려야 합니까?"

pt.L: E, chamando dois dos seus discípulos, João \v 19 [os] enviou ao Senhor, dizendo: "És {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} o que vem, ou devemos esperar outro?"
pt.B: Então João chamou dois dos seus discípulos \v 19 e os enviou ao Senhor para perguntar: "És {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} aquele que há de vir, ou devemos procurar outro?"
pt.R: Então João chamou dois dos seus seguidores. \v 19 Ele os enviou ao Senhor Jesus para perguntar: "És {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} aquele que Deus prometeu enviar? Ou devemos continuar esperando outra pessoa?"

am.L: ዮሐንስም ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለቱን ጠርቶ \v 19 እንዲህ ብሎ ወደ ጌታ ላካቸው፦ «የሚመጣው አንተ ነህ ወይስ ሌላውን እንጠባበቅ?»
am.B: ስለዚህ ዮሐንስ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለቱን ጠርቶ \v 19 እንዲህ ብለው እንዲጠይቁ ወደ ጌታ ላካቸው፦ «የሚመጣው አንተ ነህ ወይስ ሌላ ሰው እንጠብቅ?»
am.R: ስለዚህ ዮሐንስ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለቱን ጠራ። \v 19 እንዲህ ብለው እንዲጠይቁም ወደ ጌታ ኢየሱስ ላካቸው፦ «እግዚአብሔር እልካለሁ ብሎ ተስፋ የሰጠው አንተ ነህ? ወይስ ሌላ ሰው መጠበቅ አለብን?»

decisions.choice: the one who is coming: the one God promised to send
decisions.reason: John had said that one more powerful than he was coming (3:16). The prophets spoke of the LORD's messenger who comes (Malachi 3:1) and of the one who comes in the name of the LORD (Psalm 118:26; Luke 13:35).

decisions.choice: John's question: a real question, not a test for his disciples' sake
alternatives: John is sure and asks only for his disciples
decisions.reason: John had announced one who would judge with fire (3:16-17). Jesus is healing, not judging, and John is in prison. Jesus answers with what he is doing (7:22).

decisions.choice: the Lord, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: Jesus, the reading of many manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read "Jesus"; several early ones read "the Lord". The person meant is the same. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the one who is to come (B); the one who is coming (L)
decisions.reason: Balanced shows that his coming was promised.

decisions.choice: the one God promised would come
decisions.reason: Readable says why the one coming was expected, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: the Lord Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable adds the name, as in 7:13.

decisions.choice: "Thầy" for "you" and "chúng tôi" for "we" in John's question, with no setting span (also 7:20)
decisions.reason: John asks a real question (meaning decision), so he does not yet speak to Jesus as one who has confessed him Lord; "Thầy" is the respectful noun of address the style guide allows to those who respect him, and takes no span.

decisions.choice: "Đấng phải đến" (L, B); "Đấng mà Đức Chúa Trời đã hứa sẽ đến" (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase used in John 6:14 for the same title; "phải" carries the sense that his coming was promised, and Readable says so, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "오실 분" (L), "오시기로 되어 있는 분" (B), "하나님께서 보내 주시겠다고 약속하신 분" (R); "선생님" for "you", with 합쇼체 and "저희"
decisions.reason: The coming one is the one God promised to send (meaning decision), and Readable says so, as the English Readable does. John's question is a real one (meaning decision), so he addresses Jesus as a respected teacher, with the forms people use to Jesus throughout; "당신" is kept for the unclean spirits.

decisions.choice: És tu ...? (verb first)
decisions.reason: The words of John's question in Matthew 11:3. Putting the verb first is the natural Portuguese way to ask "are you the one?" with stress on "tu", and it keeps the pronoun inside the sentence, where it takes the capital-pronoun setting.

source.text: παραγενόμενοι δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ ἄνδρες εἶπαν· Ἰωάννης ὁ βαπτιστὴς ἀπέστειλεν ἡμᾶς πρὸς σὲ λέγων· Σὺ εἶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἢ ἄλλον προσδοκῶμεν;

records.literal_gloss: Having come then to him the men said, John the Baptist has sent us to you saying, You are the coming [one] or another should we wait for?

en.L: And when the men had come to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, they said, "John the Baptist has sent us to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, saying, 'Are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} the one who is coming, or should we wait for another?'"
en.B: When the men reached {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, they said, "John the Baptist sent us to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to ask, 'Are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} the one who is to come, or are we to look for someone else?'"
en.R: The men came to Jesus and said, "John the Baptist sent us to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. He wants to know, 'Are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} the one God promised would come? Or should we keep waiting for someone else?'"

es.L: Y cuando llegaron a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los hombres, dijeron: «Juan el Bautista nos ha enviado a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, diciendo: “¿Eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} el que viene, o esperamos a otro?”».
es.B: Cuando los hombres llegaron ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijeron: «Juan el Bautista nos envió a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} a preguntarte: “¿Eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} el que había de venir, o debemos esperar a otro?”».
es.R: Los hombres llegaron adonde estaba Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijeron: «Juan el Bautista nos envió a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Quiere saber: “¿Eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} aquel que Dios prometió que vendría? ¿O debemos seguir esperando a otro?”».

fr.L: Arrivés auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, les hommes dirent : « Jean le Baptiste nous a envoyés vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour dire : “Es-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} celui qui vient, ou devons-nous en attendre un autre ?” »
fr.B: Quand ils furent arrivés auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, les hommes dirent : « Jean le Baptiste nous a envoyés vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} demander : “Es-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} celui qui doit venir, ou devons-nous en attendre un autre ?” »
fr.R: Les hommes sont venus trouver Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont dit : « Jean le Baptiste nous a envoyés vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Il veut savoir : “Es-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} celui que Dieu a promis d’envoyer ? Ou devons-nous continuer à attendre quelqu’un d’autre ?” »

sw.L: Na wale watu walipofika {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, walisema, "Yohana Mbatizaji ametutuma {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}, akisema, 'Je, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiye yule anayekuja, au tumngoje mwingine?'"
sw.B: Wale watu walipomfikia, walisema, "Yohana Mbatizaji ametutuma {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} tukuulize, 'Je, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiye yule atakayekuja, au tumsubiri mtu mwingine?'"
sw.R: Wale watu walikuja kwa Yesu, wakasema, "Yohana Mbatizaji ametutuma {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}. Anataka kujua, 'Je, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiye yule ambaye Mungu aliahidi kwamba atakuja? Au tuendelee kumngoja mtu mwingine?'"

vi.L: Và khi đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, những người ấy nói: "Giăng Báp-tít đã sai chúng tôi đến với Thầy, nói rằng: 'Thầy có phải là Đấng phải đến không, hay chúng tôi phải đợi một người khác?'"
vi.B: Khi đến gặp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, những người ấy nói: "Giăng Báp-tít sai chúng tôi đến hỏi Thầy: 'Thầy có phải là Đấng phải đến không, hay chúng tôi còn phải trông đợi một người khác?'"
vi.R: Hai người ấy đến gặp Đức Giê-xu và nói: "Giăng Báp-tít sai chúng tôi đến gặp Thầy. Ông muốn biết: 'Thầy có phải là Đấng mà Đức Chúa Trời đã hứa sẽ đến không? Hay chúng tôi phải tiếp tục chờ đợi một người khác?'"

ko.L: 그 사람들이 그분께 와서 말했다. "세례자 요한이 저희를 선생님께 보내어, '오실 분이 선생님이십니까, 아니면 저희가 다른 분을 기다려야 합니까?' 하고 여쭈어 보라고 하였습니다."
ko.B: 그 사람들이 예수께 와서 말했다. "세례자 요한이 저희를 선생님께 보내어 '오시기로 되어 있는 분이 선생님이십니까? 아니면 저희가 다른 분을 기다려야 합니까?' 하고 여쭈어 보라고 하였습니다."
ko.R: 그 사람들이 예수께 와서 말했다. "세례자 요한이 저희를 선생님께 보냈습니다. 요한은 '하나님께서 보내 주시겠다고 약속하신 분이 바로 선생님이십니까? 아니면 저희가 다른 분을 계속 기다려야 합니까?' 하고 여쭈어 보라고 했습니다."

pt.L: E, quando os homens chegaram até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, disseram: "João Batista nos enviou a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, dizendo: 'És {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} o que vem, ou devemos esperar outro?'"
pt.B: Quando os homens chegaram até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, disseram: "João Batista nos enviou a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} para perguntar: 'És {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} aquele que há de vir, ou devemos procurar outro?'"
pt.R: Os homens foram até Jesus e disseram: "João Batista nos enviou a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Ele quer saber: 'És {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} aquele que Deus prometeu enviar? Ou devemos continuar esperando outra pessoa?'"

am.L: ሰዎቹም ወደ እርሱ መጥተው እንዲህ አሉ፦ «መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ “የሚመጣው አንተ ነህ ወይስ ሌላውን እንጠባበቅ?” ብሎ ወደ አንተ ልኮናል።»
am.B: ሰዎቹም ወደ እርሱ በደረሱ ጊዜ እንዲህ አሉ፦ «መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ “የሚመጣው አንተ ነህ ወይስ ሌላ ሰው እንጠብቅ?” ብለን እንድንጠይቅህ ወደ አንተ ልኮናል።»
am.R: ሰዎቹም ወደ ኢየሱስ መጥተው እንዲህ አሉ፦ «መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ ወደ አንተ ልኮናል። እንዲህ ብሎ ማወቅ ይፈልጋል፦ “እግዚአብሔር እልካለሁ ብሎ ተስፋ የሰጠው አንተ ነህ? ወይስ ሌላ ሰው መጠበቅ አለብን?”»

decisions.choice: the Baptist: the one who baptizes
alternatives: a member of a group called Baptists
decisions.reason: The title marks John by what he did (3:3). This is the first time Luke uses it (also 7:33; 9:19).

decisions.choice: the question repeated word for word
decisions.reason: Luke repeats John's question in full, which gives it weight.

decisions.choice: the one God promised would come
decisions.reason: As in 7:19.

decisions.choice: Jean le Baptiste (for the whole chapter)
decisions.reason: As the style guide sets for the New Testament: the title says what John did, "the one who baptizes" (m1), which the hyphenated first name "Jean-Baptiste" hides.

decisions.choice: "Giăng Báp-tít" at every level
decisions.reason: Here Luke uses the title, not the participle that Mark 1:4 Literal renders "người làm báp-têm", so every level gives the title Protestant readers know, as Matthew 3:1 does.

decisions.choice: "세례자 요한" at every level
decisions.reason: The form used in Mark and Matthew in Korean; it says what the title means, the one who baptizes (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: the repeated question placed before "ብሎ ወደ አንተ ልኮናል" (he has sent us to you, saying)
alternatives: the question after the verb, as in the Greek
decisions.reason: Amharic puts the words quoted before the verb of saying, so in Literal and Balanced John's question comes inside the sentence rather than at its end; the quotation itself is the same.

source.text: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐθεράπευσεν πολλοὺς ἀπὸ νόσων καὶ μαστίγων καὶ πνευμάτων πονηρῶν, καὶ τυφλοῖς πολλοῖς ἐχαρίσατο βλέπειν.

records.literal_gloss: In that the hour he healed many from diseases and afflictions and spirits evil, and to blind many he granted to see.

en.L: In that hour {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} healed many of diseases and afflictions and evil spirits, and to many blind [people] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} granted sight.
en.B: Just then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} healed many people of diseases, painful illnesses and evil spirits, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave many blind people the gift of sight.
en.R: At that very time Jesus was healing many people. Some had diseases or terrible pains, and some had evil spirits. Jesus also made many blind people able to see.

es.L: En aquella hora sanó a muchos de enfermedades, dolencias y espíritus malignos, y a muchos ciegos les concedió ver.
es.B: En ese mismo momento sanó a muchos de enfermedades, de dolencias penosas y de espíritus malignos, y a muchos ciegos les dio el don de la vista.
es.R: En ese mismo momento Jesús estaba sanando a mucha gente. Algunos tenían enfermedades o dolores terribles, y otros tenían espíritus malignos. Jesús también hizo que muchos ciegos pudieran ver.

fr.L: À cette heure-là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} guérit beaucoup [de gens] de maladies, d’infirmités et d’esprits mauvais, et à beaucoup d’aveugles {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} accorda de voir.
fr.B: Au même moment, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} guérit beaucoup de gens de leurs maladies, de leurs souffrances et des esprits mauvais, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fit à beaucoup d’aveugles le don de la vue.
fr.R: À ce moment-là, Jésus guérissait beaucoup de gens. Certains avaient des maladies ou de grandes douleurs, et d’autres avaient des esprits mauvais. Jésus a aussi permis à beaucoup d’aveugles de voir.

sw.L: Saa ile ile aliwaponya wengi magonjwa na mateso na pepo wabaya, na vipofu wengi aliwajalia kuona.
sw.B: Wakati huo huo aliwaponya watu wengi waliokuwa na magonjwa, maradhi yenye maumivu makali na pepo wabaya, na akawapa vipofu wengi zawadi ya kuona.
sw.R: Wakati huo huo Yesu alikuwa akiponya watu wengi. Baadhi yao walikuwa na magonjwa au maumivu makali, na wengine walikuwa na pepo wabaya. Yesu aliwafanya pia vipofu wengi waweze kuona.

vi.L: Ngay giờ đó {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chữa lành nhiều người khỏi bệnh tật, đau đớn, và tà linh, và ban cho nhiều người mù được thấy.
vi.B: Ngay lúc ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chữa lành cho nhiều người mắc bệnh tật, những chứng đau đớn và bị tà linh ám, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho nhiều người mù được sáng mắt.
vi.R: Ngay lúc đó, Đức Giê-xu đang chữa lành cho nhiều người. Có người mắc bệnh, có người bị đau đớn khủng khiếp, và có người bị tà linh hành hạ. Đức Giê-xu cũng làm cho nhiều người mù được thấy.

ko.L: 바로 그때에 그분은 많은 사람을 질병과 고통과 악한 영들에게서 고쳐 주셨고, 많은 눈먼 사람들에게 보는 것을 선물로 주셨다.
ko.B: 바로 그때 예수께서는 질병과 고통스러운 병과 악한 영에 시달리던 많은 사람을 고쳐 주시고, 많은 눈먼 사람들이 볼 수 있게 해 주셨다.
ko.R: 바로 그때 예수께서는 많은 사람을 고쳐 주고 계셨다. 어떤 사람들은 병이 들었고, 어떤 사람들은 심한 고통에 시달렸고, 어떤 사람들은 악한 영이 들려 있었다. 예수께서는 또 많은 눈먼 사람들이 볼 수 있게 해 주셨다.

pt.L: Naquela hora {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} curou muitos de doenças, e de males, e de espíritos maus, e a muitos cegos {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} concedeu a vista.
pt.B: Naquele momento, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} curou muitas pessoas de doenças, de males dolorosos e de espíritos maus, e deu a muitos cegos o dom da vista.
pt.R: Nessa mesma hora, Jesus estava curando muitas pessoas. Algumas tinham doenças ou dores terríveis, e outras tinham espíritos maus. Jesus também fez muitos cegos voltarem a enxergar.

am.L: በዚያችም ሰዓት ብዙዎችን ከበሽታዎችና ከሥቃዮች ከክፉዎችም መናፍስት ፈወሰ፤ ለብዙ ዓይነ ስውሮችም ማየትን ሰጠ።
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ ብዙ ሰዎችን ከበሽታ፣ ከሚያሠቃይ ሕመምና ከክፉ መናፍስት ፈወሰ፤ ለብዙ ዓይነ ስውሮችም የማየትን ስጦታ ሰጣቸው።
am.R: በዚያኑ ጊዜ ኢየሱስ ብዙ ሰዎችን ይፈውስ ነበር። አንዳንዶቹ በሽታ ወይም ከባድ ሕመም ነበረባቸው፤ አንዳንዶቹ ደግሞ ክፉ መናፍስት ነበሩባቸው። ኢየሱስ ብዙ ዓይነ ስውሮችንም እንዲያዩ አደረገ።

decisions.choice: afflictions: painful illnesses
decisions.reason: The word means a whip or a lash, and so a suffering that strikes like one (Mark 5:29, 34).

decisions.choice: granted: gave as a free gift
decisions.reason: The verb means to give freely, as a favor. It is used again in 7:42-43 of canceling a debt.

decisions.choice: in that hour: while John's messengers were there
decisions.reason: The healings take place before their eyes, so that they can tell John what they have seen (7:22).

decisions.choice: Jesus was healing
decisions.reason: Readable names Jesus and breaks the list into short sentences.

decisions.choice: pepo wabaya, at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek here says "evil spirits", not "unclean spirits", so every level says "pepo wabaya" rather than the book-wide "pepo mchafu" for the other phrase.

decisions.choice: "tà linh" for evil spirits at every level
decisions.reason: Luke's word here is "evil", not "unclean", so the settled "linh ô uế" does not apply; "tà linh" is the plain word for an evil spirit, as Matthew 8:16 uses it.

decisions.choice: "đau đớn" for the afflictions (literally "whips")
decisions.reason: As in Mark 3:10: the Greek pictures painful illness as a scourge, which the meaning decision explains; Vietnamese names the pain.

decisions.choice: "악한 영" at every level for pneumata ponēra; "선물로 주셨다" (L) for echarisato
decisions.reason: Luke's word here is "evil", not "unclean", so Literal and Balanced say "악한 영" as well as Readable. The verb means to give as a free gift (meaning decision), which Literal keeps.

source.text: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Πορευθέντες ἀπαγγείλατε Ἰωάννῃ ἃ εἴδετε καὶ ἠκούσατε· τυφλοὶ ἀναβλέπουσιν, χωλοὶ περιπατοῦσιν, λεπροὶ καθαρίζονται, κωφοὶ ἀκούουσιν, νεκροὶ ἐγείρονται, πτωχοὶ εὐαγγελίζονται·

records.literal_gloss: And answering he said to them, Having gone report to John what you saw and heard: blind receive sight, lame walk, lepers are cleansed, deaf hear, dead are raised, poor have good news proclaimed;

en.L: And answering, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Go and report to John what you have seen and heard: blind [people] receive sight, lame [people] walk, lepers are cleansed, and deaf [people] hear, dead [people] are raised, poor [people] have good news proclaimed [to them];
en.B: So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} answered them, "Go back and tell John what you have seen and heard. The blind see again, the lame walk, people with leprosy are made clean, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the poor hear the good news.
en.R: Jesus answered John's followers, "Go back and tell John what you have seen and heard. Blind people can see. People who could not walk are walking. People with skin diseases are healed and made clean. Deaf people can hear. Dead people are raised to life. And poor people are hearing the good news.

es.L: Y respondiendo, les dijo: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} y {{plural_you:anuncien|anunciad}} a Juan lo que {{plural_you:han visto y oído|habéis visto y oído}}: [los] ciegos recobran la vista, [los] cojos andan, [los] leprosos son limpiados, y [los] sordos oyen, [los] muertos son resucitados, a [los] pobres se les anuncia la buena noticia;
es.B: Así que les respondió: «{{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} y {{plural_you:cuéntenle|contadle}} a Juan lo que {{plural_you:han visto y oído|habéis visto y oído}}. Los ciegos vuelven a ver, los cojos andan, los que tienen lepra quedan limpios, los sordos oyen, los muertos son resucitados y a los pobres se les anuncia la buena noticia.
es.R: Jesús les respondió a los discípulos de Juan: «{{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} y {{plural_you:cuéntenle|contadle}} a Juan lo que {{plural_you:han visto y oído|habéis visto y oído}}. Los ciegos pueden ver. Los que no podían caminar están caminando. Los que tenían enfermedades de la piel son sanados y quedan limpios. Los sordos pueden oír. Los muertos son resucitados. Y los pobres están oyendo la buena noticia.

fr.L: Et répondant, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Allez rapporter à Jean ce que vous avez vu et entendu : des aveugles retrouvent la vue, des boiteux marchent, des lépreux sont purifiés, des sourds entendent, des morts sont ressuscités, à des pauvres la bonne nouvelle est annoncée ;
fr.B: Il leur répondit : « Retournez dire à Jean ce que vous avez vu et entendu. Les aveugles voient de nouveau, les boiteux marchent, les lépreux sont rendus purs, les sourds entendent, les morts sont ressuscités, et les pauvres entendent la bonne nouvelle.
fr.R: Jésus a répondu aux disciples de Jean : « Retournez dire à Jean ce que vous avez vu et entendu. Les aveugles voient. Ceux qui ne pouvaient pas marcher marchent. Les gens qui avaient une maladie de peau sont guéris et redeviennent purs. Les sourds entendent. Les morts reviennent à la vie. Et les pauvres entendent la bonne nouvelle.

sw.L: Naye akajibu, akawaambia, "Nendeni mkamweleze Yohana mliyoyaona na kuyasikia: vipofu wanapata kuona, viwete wanatembea, wakoma wanatakaswa, na viziwi wanasikia, wafu wanafufuliwa, maskini wanahubiriwa habari njema;
sw.B: Basi aliwajibu, "Rudini mkamweleze Yohana mambo mliyoyaona na kuyasikia. Vipofu wanaona tena, viwete wanatembea, wenye ukoma wanafanywa safi, viziwi wanasikia, wafu wanafufuliwa, na maskini wanasikia habari njema.
sw.R: Yesu aliwajibu wanafunzi wa Yohana, "Rudini mkamweleze Yohana mambo mliyoyaona na kuyasikia. Vipofu wanaweza kuona. Watu ambao hawakuweza kutembea wanatembea. Watu wenye magonjwa ya ngozi wanaponywa na kufanywa safi. Viziwi wanaweza kusikia. Wafu wanafufuliwa. Na maskini wanasikia habari njema.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trả lời họ: "Hãy đi báo cho Giăng những gì các anh đã thấy và nghe: người mù được thấy, người què đi được, người phung được sạch, và người điếc được nghe, người chết được sống lại, người nghèo được nghe rao truyền Tin Lành;
vi.B: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trả lời họ: "Hãy về kể lại cho Giăng những gì các anh đã thấy và nghe: người mù được sáng mắt, người què đi được, người mắc bệnh ngoài da nặng được sạch, người điếc nghe được, người chết sống lại, và người nghèo được nghe Tin Lành.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời các môn đồ của Giăng: "Hãy về kể lại cho Giăng những gì các anh đã thấy và nghe. Người mù thấy được. Người không đi được nay đã đi được. Người bị bệnh phong, một bệnh ngoài da rất nặng, được lành và được sạch. Người điếc nghe được. Người chết được sống lại. Và người nghèo đang được nghe Tin Lành.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 대답하여 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "가서 너희가 보고 들은 것을 요한에게 알려라. 눈먼 사람들이 다시 보고, 다리 저는 사람들이 걷고, 나병 환자들이 깨끗해지고, 듣지 못하는 사람들이 듣고, 죽은 사람들이 살아나고, 가난한 사람들에게 복음이 전해진다.
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 대답하셨다. "돌아가서 너희가 보고 들은 것을 요한에게 전하여라. 눈먼 사람들이 다시 보고, 다리를 저는 사람들이 걷고, 악성 피부병에 걸린 사람들이 깨끗해지고, 듣지 못하는 사람들이 듣고, 죽은 사람들이 살아나고, 가난한 사람들이 복음을 듣는다.
ko.R: 예수께서 요한의 제자들에게 대답하셨다. "돌아가서 너희가 보고 들은 것을 요한에게 전하여라. 눈먼 사람들이 본다. 걷지 못하던 사람들이 걷는다. 심한 피부병을 앓던 사람들이 나아서 깨끗해진다. 듣지 못하던 사람들이 듣는다. 죽은 사람들이 다시 살아난다. 그리고 가난한 사람들이 기쁜 소식을 듣는다.

pt.L: E, respondendo, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Vão e contem a João o que vocês viram e ouviram: cegos voltam a ver, coxos andam, leprosos são purificados, e surdos ouvem, mortos são ressuscitados, [aos] pobres são anunciadas boas-novas;
pt.B: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes respondeu: "Voltem e contem a João o que vocês viram e ouviram. Os cegos voltam a ver, os coxos andam, os leprosos são purificados, os surdos ouvem, os mortos são ressuscitados, e os pobres ouvem as boas-novas.
pt.R: Jesus respondeu aos seguidores de João: "Voltem e contem a João o que vocês viram e ouviram. Os cegos estão enxergando. As pessoas que não podiam andar estão andando. As pessoas com doenças de pele são curadas e ficam puras. Os surdos estão ouvindo. Os mortos voltam à vida. E os pobres estão ouvindo as boas-novas.

am.L: መልሶም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ሄዳችሁ ያያችሁትንና የሰማችሁትን ለዮሐንስ ንገሩት፤ ዓይነ ስውሮች ዓይናቸው ይበራል፤ አንካሶችም ይመላለሳሉ፤ ለምጻሞች ይነጻሉ፤ መስማት የተሳናቸውም ይሰማሉ፤ ሙታን ይነሣሉ፤ ለድሆችም ወንጌል ይሰበክላቸዋል፤
am.B: እርሱም እንዲህ ሲል መለሰላቸው፦ «ተመልሳችሁ ያያችሁትንና የሰማችሁትን ለዮሐንስ ንገሩት። ዓይነ ስውሮች ያያሉ፤ አንካሶች ይራመዳሉ፤ ለምጽ ያለባቸው ይነጻሉ፤ መስማት የተሳናቸው ይሰማሉ፤ ሙታን ወደ ሕይወት ይነሣሉ፤ ድሆችም ወንጌልን ይሰማሉ።
am.R: ኢየሱስም ለዮሐንስ ደቀ መዛሙርት እንዲህ ሲል መለሰላቸው፦ «ተመልሳችሁ ሂዱና ስላያችሁትና ስለ ሰማችሁት ነገር ለዮሐንስ ንገሩት። ዓይነ ስውሮች እንደ ገና ያያሉ። መራመድ የማይችሉ ሰዎች ይራመዳሉ። የቆዳ በሽታ ያለባቸው ሰዎች ተፈውሰው ይነጻሉ። መስማት የተሳናቸው ይሰማሉ። የሞቱ ሰዎች ወደ ሕይወት ይመለሳሉ። ድሆችም የምሥራቹን ይሰማሉ።

decisions.choice: the list echoes Isaiah's promises of what God would do
decisions.reason: Isaiah promised that the blind would see, the deaf hear and the lame leap (Isaiah 35:5-6; 29:18), that the dead would live (Isaiah 26:19), and that good news would come to the poor (Isaiah 61:1, read by Jesus in 4:18). Jesus answers John's question with the deeds the prophets promised.

decisions.choice: lepers: people with a skin disease that made them unclean under the law
alternatives: people with the disease now called leprosy only
decisions.reason: As in 5:12, the word covered several skin diseases (Leviticus 13). Healing meant they could be declared clean and return to their community.

decisions.choice: the poor have good news proclaimed: the climax of the list
decisions.reason: The list ends with the poor, as in Jesus's reading of Isaiah (4:18). The verb is the one for telling good news (1:19; 3:18).

decisions.choice: people with skin diseases
decisions.reason: As in 5:12, Readable describes the disease instead of naming it.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and closes at the end of 7:23
decisions.reason: Jesus's answer runs on into 7:23.

decisions.choice: la buena noticia, at every level
decisions.reason: The verb is the telling of good news, not the name of the message, so every level says "la buena noticia", as the English says "good news".

decisions.choice: la bonne nouvelle at every level
decisions.reason: As the style guide sets for the Gospels: where the English says "good news" French says "la bonne nouvelle" at every level. Here the Greek is a verb, "to have good news announced", and the climax of the list (m3) is that the poor hear it, not a name for the message.

decisions.choice: purifiés (L); rendus purs (B)
decisions.reason: As in Mark: the verb is the one for making clean under the law (m2), so French uses "pur, purifier" and not only "guérir"; Readable says both, as the English does.

decisions.choice: habari njema, at every level
decisions.reason: The verb is the telling of good news, not the name of the message, so every level says "habari njema", as the English says "good news".

decisions.choice: Jesus calls John's messengers "các anh"
decisions.reason: They come with an honest question from John and are not opponents; "các anh" is the ordinary respectful word for grown men, as Jesus uses it to the fishermen in 5:4.

decisions.choice: "người phung" (L); "người mắc bệnh ngoài da nặng" (B); "bệnh phong, một bệnh ngoài da rất nặng" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Luke 4:27 and 5:12: the Greek word covered several serious skin diseases (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "được nghe rao truyền Tin Lành" (L); "được nghe Tin Lành" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Tin Lành" is the settled word for the good news at every level, as in 4:18; the passive verb is rendered "được nghe", so the poor are the ones who receive it.

decisions.choice: "나병 환자" (L), "악성 피부병에 걸린 사람" (B), "심한 피부병을 앓던 사람" (R); "복음" (L, B), "기쁜 소식" (R)
decisions.reason: The disease words of Luke 5:12 and Matthew 8:2 in Korean, and the settled words for the good news. The verb is "have good news proclaimed"; Korean has no single verb for it, so Literal says the good news "is proclaimed" to them.

decisions.choice: "ዓይነ ስውሮች" (the blind); "መስማት የተሳናቸው" (the deaf)
decisions.reason: "ዕውር" and "ደንቆሮ" are the old words, but today they are heard as insults; "ዓይነ ስውር" and "መስማት የተሳነው" are the ordinary respectful words and say the same, as in the parallel Matthew 11:5.

source.text: καὶ μακάριός ἐστιν ὃς ἐὰν μὴ σκανδαλισθῇ ἐν ἐμοί.

records.literal_gloss: And blessed is whoever not is caused to stumble in me.

en.L: And blessed is whoever is not caused to stumble because of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.B: And blessed is anyone who does not find in {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a reason to fall away."
en.R: How blessed is anyone who does not stumble and turn away because of what I do!"

es.L: Y dichoso es aquel que no tropiece por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}».
es.B: Y dichoso el que no encuentre en {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} motivo para apartarse».
es.R: ¡Qué dichoso es el que no tropieza ni se aparta por causa de lo que hago!».

fr.L: Et heureux est celui qui ne trébuchera pas à cause de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »
fr.B: Heureux celui qui ne trouve pas en {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} une raison de se détourner. »
fr.R: Heureux celui qui ne trébuche pas et ne se détourne pas à cause de ce que je fais ! »

sw.L: Na heri yeye ambaye hatakwazwa kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}."
sw.B: Na heri mtu yeyote asiyepata ndani {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} sababu ya kuniacha."
sw.R: Heri kweli mtu asiyejikwaa na kuniacha kwa sababu ya mambo ninayoyafanya!"

vi.L: Và phước cho người nào không vấp ngã vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.B: Phước cho người nào không vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà vấp ngã."
vi.R: Người nào không vấp ngã và quay lưng với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vì những việc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm thật có phước!"

ko.L: 그리고 누구든지 나 때문에 걸려 넘어지지 않는 사람은 복이 있다."
ko.B: 누구든지 나 때문에 걸려 넘어져 나에게서 등을 돌리지 않는 사람은 복이 있다."
ko.R: 내가 하는 일 때문에 걸려 넘어져서 나를 떠나지 않는 사람은 얼마나 복된 사람이냐!"

pt.L: E bem-aventurado é aquele que não tropeçar por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}."
pt.B: E bem-aventurado é todo aquele que não encontra em {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} motivo para se afastar."
pt.R: Feliz é a pessoa que não tropeça nem se afasta por causa do que eu faço!"

am.L: በእኔም የማይሰናከል የተባረከ ነው።»
am.B: በእኔ ምክንያት የማይሰናከል ሰው የተባረከ ነው።»
am.R: በማደርገው ነገር የማይሰናከልና ከእኔ የማይርቅ ሰው ምንኛ የተባረከ ነው!»

decisions.choice: caused to stumble: tripped up, so as to turn away from Jesus
decisions.reason: The verb comes from the word for a trap or a stumbling block. It means to be led to fall away, not just to feel hurt. Jesus does not fit what some expect (7:34), and they turn from him.

decisions.choice: blessed: fortunate in God's eyes
decisions.reason: The word is the one of the blessings in 6:20-22.

decisions.choice: because of what I do
decisions.reason: Readable links the saying to the deeds of 7:22, which did not look like the judgment John announced.

decisions.choice: How blessed is anyone
decisions.reason: Readable makes the declaration an exclamation, as in 6:20.

decisions.choice: dichoso
decisions.reason: Fortunate in God's eyes (meaning decision m2). "Bienaventurado" is the traditional church word but sounds old to many readers; "feliz" can sound like a mood. "Dichoso" is current and keeps the sense of good fortune given.

decisions.choice: heureux at every level
decisions.reason: The word means fortunate in God's eyes (m2). French "béni" belongs to another Greek word, "blessed" by God or by people; "bienheureux" now sounds like church language. "Heureux celui qui …" is the French form of a declaration of happiness, as in the Beatitudes of 6:20-22.

decisions.choice: heri
decisions.reason: Fortunate in God's eyes (meaning decision m2). "Heri" is the settled word for this saying; "amebarikiwa" would make it a statement about a blessing received rather than a declaration of good fortune.

decisions.choice: "vấp ngã" for "caused to stumble"; "quay lưng" added at Readable
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says tripped up so as to turn away from Jesus; "vấp ngã" keeps the picture in plain modern words, where "vấp phạm" is older church language. Readable says where the stumbling leads.

decisions.choice: "걸려 넘어지다" (L); "걸려 넘어져 ... 등을 돌리다" (B); "걸려 넘어져서 ... 떠나다" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is to be tripped up so as to turn away from Jesus (meaning decision); "실족하다" is the older church word and is no longer understood in this sense. "복이 있다" and the Readable exclamation are as in 6:20.

decisions.choice: "የተባረከ" (blessed)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew, "የተባረከ" says that God favours the person, in a word every reader knows; "ብፁዕ" is Ge'ez, and "ደስተኛ" describes a feeling rather than God's favour.

source.text: Ἀπελθόντων δὲ τῶν ἀγγέλων Ἰωάννου ἤρξατο λέγειν πρὸς τοὺς ὄχλους περὶ Ἰωάννου· Τί ἐξήλθατε εἰς τὴν ἔρημον θεάσασθαι;

records.literal_gloss: Having departed then the messengers of John he began to speak to the crowds concerning John, What did you go out into the wilderness to look at?

en.L: When John's messengers had left, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} began to speak to the crowds about John: "What did you go out into the wilderness to look at?
en.B: After John's messengers had gone, Jesus began to talk to the crowds about John. "What did you go out into the wilderness to see?
en.R: When John's messengers had left, Jesus began to talk to the crowds about John. He said, "When you went out into the desert to see John, what did you expect to see?

es.L: Cuando se fueron los mensajeros de Juan, comenzó a decir a las multitudes acerca de Juan: «¿Qué {{plural_you:salieron|salisteis}} a contemplar al desierto?
es.B: Después de que se fueron los mensajeros de Juan, Jesús comenzó a hablar a la gente acerca de Juan: «¿Qué {{plural_you:salieron|salisteis}} a ver al desierto?
es.R: Cuando los mensajeros de Juan se fueron, Jesús comenzó a hablar a la gente acerca de Juan. Les dijo: «Cuando {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} al desierto a ver a Juan, ¿qué {{plural_you:esperaban|esperabais}} ver?

fr.L: Les messagers de Jean étant partis, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se mit à parler aux foules au sujet de Jean : « Qu’êtes-vous sortis regarder dans le désert ?
fr.B: Après le départ des messagers de Jean, Jésus se mit à parler de Jean aux foules : « Qu’êtes-vous allés voir au désert ?
fr.R: Quand les messagers de Jean sont partis, Jésus a commencé à parler de Jean aux foules. Il a dit : « Quand vous êtes allés dans le désert pour voir Jean, qu’est-ce que vous vous attendiez à voir ?

sw.L: Wajumbe wa Yohana walipokwisha kuondoka, alianza kuwaambia umati wa watu habari za Yohana, "Mlitoka kwenda nyikani kutazama nini?
sw.B: Wajumbe wa Yohana walipoondoka, Yesu alianza kuzungumza na umati wa watu kuhusu Yohana. "Mlikwenda nyikani kuona nini?
sw.R: Wajumbe wa Yohana walipoondoka, Yesu alianza kuongea na umati wa watu kuhusu Yohana. Akasema, "Mlipokwenda jangwani kumwona Yohana, mlitarajia kuona nini?

vi.L: Khi các sứ giả của Giăng đã đi rồi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bắt đầu nói với đoàn dân về Giăng: "Các người đã đi ra đồng hoang để xem gì?
vi.B: Sau khi các sứ giả của Giăng đi rồi, Đức Giê-xu bắt đầu nói với đoàn dân về Giăng: "Các người đã đi ra đồng hoang để xem gì?
vi.R: Sau khi các sứ giả của Giăng đi rồi, Đức Giê-xu bắt đầu nói với dân chúng về Giăng. Ngài nói: "Khi các người đi ra sa mạc để gặp Giăng, các người mong được thấy gì?

ko.L: 요한의 사자들이 떠나간 뒤에, 그분은 무리에게 요한에 대하여 말씀하기 시작하셨다. "너희는 무엇을 구경하러 광야에 나갔느냐?
ko.B: 요한이 보낸 사람들이 떠나가자, 예수께서 무리에게 요한에 대하여 말씀하기 시작하셨다. "너희는 무엇을 보러 광야에 나갔느냐?
ko.R: 요한이 보낸 사람들이 떠난 뒤에, 예수께서 사람들에게 요한에 대하여 말씀하기 시작하셨다. "너희가 요한을 보러 광야에 나갔을 때, 무엇을 보리라고 생각했느냐?

pt.L: Tendo partido os mensageiros de João, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} começou a falar às multidões a respeito de João: "O que vocês saíram ao deserto para contemplar?
pt.B: Depois que os mensageiros de João foram embora, Jesus começou a falar às multidões sobre João. "O que vocês foram ver no deserto?
pt.R: Quando os mensageiros de João foram embora, Jesus começou a falar às multidões sobre João. Ele disse: "Quando vocês foram ao deserto para ver João, o que esperavam ver?

am.R: የዮሐንስ መልእክተኞች ከሄዱ በኋላ ኢየሱስ ስለ ዮሐንስ ለሕዝቡ መናገር ጀመረ። እንዲህም አለ፦ «ዮሐንስን ለማየት ወደ በረሃ በወጣችሁ ጊዜ ምን ታያላችሁ ብላችሁ ጠብቃችሁ ነበር?

decisions.choice: messengers: people sent with a message
decisions.reason: The word can mean angel, but here it is John's two disciples. Jesus will use the same word of John himself in 7:27.

decisions.choice: the wilderness: the dry country near the Jordan where John preached
decisions.reason: Crowds went out to hear John and be baptized (3:2-7).

decisions.choice: to look at: to gaze at, as at a sight
decisions.reason: The verb means to look closely at something worth seeing.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jesus at the start of a new section.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and closes at the end of 7:28
decisions.reason: Jesus's words about John run on through 7:28.

decisions.choice: desert
decisions.reason: Readable uses the everyday word for dry, empty country.

decisions.choice: le désert at every level
decisions.reason: As in Mark: French "désert" covers the empty, dry country by the Jordan (m2), not only sand, so one word serves every level where English needs "wilderness" and "desert".

decisions.choice: nyika (L, B); jangwa (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice: "nyika" is the dry, open country where John preached (meaning decision m2); Readable says "jangwa", as the English Readable says "desert".

decisions.choice: "sứ giả" for John's messengers
decisions.reason: The Greek word is the one usually rendered "angel", but here it means human messengers (meaning decision); "sứ giả" is the same word used for the messenger in 7:27, as the meaning decision there notes.

decisions.choice: "đồng hoang" (L, B); "sa mạc" (R) for the wilderness
decisions.reason: As in Mark 1:3-4 and Luke 4:1.

decisions.choice: "사자들" (L), "요한이 보낸 사람들" (B, R); "광야" at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek word for messenger can also mean angel; Literal keeps "사자", the word used for God's messenger in 7:27 (as in Mark 1:2 in Korean), so the link stays. "광야" is the word of Mark 1 in Korean for the dry country where John preached; "사막" would suggest sand dunes.

decisions.choice: "ምድረ በዳ" (L, B); "በረሃ" (R)
decisions.reason: "ምድረ በዳ" is the wild, empty country where John preached, as in Matthew 11:7; Readable says "በረሃ", the everyday word, as the English Readable says "desert".

decisions.choice: a reed shaken by the wind: a weak, changeable person

decisions.reason: Reeds grew thick along the Jordan, and people would have seen them. But a reed that bends with every wind is also a picture of weakness (1 Kings 14:15; 2 Kings 18:21). John was no such man; he spoke the same hard truth to everyone, even Herod (3:19).

decisions.choice: a question that expects the answer no
decisions.reason: The question is ironic: no one went out to the wilderness to stare at reeds.

decisions.reason: Readable spells out what "yes" agrees with.

source.text: οὗτός ἐστιν περὶ οὗ γέγραπται· Ἰδοὺ ἀποστέλλω τὸν ἄγγελόν μου πρὸ προσώπου σου, ὃς κατασκευάσει τὴν ὁδόν σου ἔμπροσθέν σου.

records.literal_gloss: This is [he] concerning whom it has been written, Look, I send the messenger of me before face of you, who will prepare the way of you before you.

en.L: This is [the one] about whom it is written: 'Look, I send {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} messenger before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face, who will prepare {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} way before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.'
en.B: He is the one of whom Scripture says, 'I am sending {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} messenger to go before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; he will make {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} road ready ahead of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.'
en.R: John is the one the Scriptures speak about. There God says to the one who is to come, 'I am sending {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} messenger ahead of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. He will get the road ready for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.'

es.L: Este es [aquel] de quien está escrito: “Mira, envío a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mensajero delante de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro, el cual preparará {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} camino delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}”.
es.B: Él es aquel de quien dice la Escritura: “Envío a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mensajero para que vaya delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; él dejará listo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} camino por delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}”.
es.R: Juan es aquel de quien hablan las Escrituras. Allí Dios dice al que había de venir: “Envío a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mensajero delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Él {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} preparará el camino”.

fr.L: Celui-ci est [celui] dont il est écrit : “Voici, j’envoie {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} messager devant {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face, qui préparera {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} chemin devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.”
fr.B: C’est de lui que l’Écriture dit : “J’envoie {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} messager devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; il préparera {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} chemin devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.”
fr.R: Jean est celui dont parlent les Écritures. Là, Dieu dit à celui qui doit venir : “J’envoie {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} messager devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Il préparera la route pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.”

sw.L: Huyu ndiye ambaye imeandikwa habari zake, 'Tazama, ninamtuma mjumbe {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, ambaye ataitengeneza njia {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.'
sw.B: Yeye ndiye ambaye Maandiko yanasema habari zake, 'Ninamtuma mjumbe {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} atangulie mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; yeye ataitayarisha njia {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.'
sw.R: Yohana ndiye yule ambaye Maandiko yanasema habari zake. Huko Mungu anamwambia yule atakayekuja, 'Ninamtuma mjumbe {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} akutangulie. Yeye atakuandalia njia.'

vi.L: Đây là người mà Kinh Thánh đã chép về: 'Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sai sứ giả của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đi trước mặt Con, người sẽ dọn đường của Con trước Con.'
vi.B: Ông chính là người mà Kinh Thánh đã chép: 'Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sai sứ giả của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đi trước Con; người ấy sẽ sửa soạn đường cho Con.'
vi.R: Kinh Thánh đã nói về Giăng. Ở đó, Đức Chúa Trời phán với Đấng sẽ đến: 'Ta sai sứ giả của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đi trước Con. Người ấy sẽ dọn đường sẵn cho Con.'

ko.L: 이 사람은, 그에 대하여 이렇게 기록되어 있는 사람이다. '보라, 내가 내 사자를 네 얼굴 앞에 보낸다. 그가 네 앞에서 네 길을 마련할 것이다.'
ko.B: 그는 성경에 이렇게 기록된 바로 그 사람이다. '내가 내 사자를 너보다 앞서 보낸다. 그가 네 앞에서 네 길을 닦아 놓을 것이다.'
ko.R: 성경은 바로 요한에 대하여 말하고 있다. 거기서 하나님께서는 오실 분에게 이렇게 말씀하신다. '내가 내 심부름꾼을 너보다 먼저 보낸다. 그가 너를 위해 길을 준비할 것이다.'

pt.L: Este é [aquele] a respeito de quem está escrito: 'Eis que envio o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} mensageiro diante da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} face, o qual preparará o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} caminho diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.'
pt.B: Ele é aquele de quem a Escritura diz: 'Estou enviando o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} mensageiro à {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} frente; ele vai aprontar o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} caminho adiante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.'
pt.R: João é aquele de quem as Escrituras falam. Ali Deus diz àquele que havia de vir: 'Vou enviar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} mensageiro à {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} frente. Ele vai preparar o caminho para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.'

am.L: ይህ ስለ እርሱ እንዲህ ተብሎ የተጻፈለት ነው፦ “እነሆ፣ በፊትህ መንገድህን የሚያዘጋጀውን መልእክተኛዬን ከፊትህ እልካለሁ።”
am.B: መጽሐፍ እንዲህ የሚለው ስለዚህ ሰው ነው፦ “መልእክተኛዬን ከአንተ አስቀድሜ እልካለሁ፤ እርሱም በፊትህ መንገድህን ያዘጋጃል።”
am.R: ቅዱሳት መጻሕፍት የሚናገሩት ስለ ዮሐንስ ነው። በዚያ እግዚአብሔር ለሚመጣው እንዲህ ይላል፦ “መልእክተኛዬን ከአንተ በፊት እልካለሁ። እርሱም መንገድህን ያዘጋጅልሃል።”

decisions.choice: Malachi 3:1, with words from Exodus 23:20
decisions.reason: In Malachi 3:1 God says, "I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me." The words "before your face" come from Exodus 23:20, where God sends his angel before Israel. Mark 1:2 and Matthew 11:10 quote the same words.

decisions.choice: you and your: God speaks to the one who is to come, that is, to Jesus
decisions.reason: In Malachi the messenger prepares the way before the LORD himself. In Luke's quotation God speaks to another, and the messenger prepares that one's way. So the coming of Jesus is the coming of the LORD that Malachi promised (compare 1:76; 3:4). This answers John's question of 7:19.

decisions.choice: my messenger: God is the speaker
decisions.reason: In Malachi the speaker is the LORD of hosts. John is the messenger God sends.

decisions.choice: messenger: the same word as in 7:24
decisions.reason: John sent messengers to Jesus; John himself is God's messenger.

decisions.choice: my (God speaking) and you, your (spoken to Jesus), with the capital-pronoun setting
decisions.reason: God speaks of himself, and he speaks to Jesus, so both take the capital-pronoun setting. "He" is the messenger, John, and takes no setting.

decisions.choice: There God says to the one who is to come
decisions.reason: Readable names the speaker and the one spoken to, as the meaning decisions explain.

decisions.choice: to go before you (B); before your face (L)
decisions.reason: "Before your face" is a Hebrew way of saying "ahead of you". Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: está escrito (L); dice la Escritura (B); hablan las Escrituras (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for the formula that introduces Scripture: Literal keeps the passive "está escrito"; Balanced and Readable name the Scriptures, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "j’envoie" without a span; "mon" (God), "ta", "ton", "toi" (Jesus) with the capital-pronoun setting
decisions.reason: As the English: God speaks of himself and to Jesus, so their pronouns take the setting; "il", the messenger, is John and takes none. French writes "je" for God without a span, as it does for Jesus.

decisions.choice: imeandikwa (L); Maandiko yanasema (B, R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for the formula that introduces Scripture: Literal keeps the passive; Balanced and Readable name the Scriptures, as the English does.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} for God; {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} for the one addressed
decisions.reason: God speaks, and the one he speaks to is Jesus (meaning decision m2), so the possessives for both take the setting. Readable's "akutangulie", "atakuandalia" carry "you" in the verb and take none.

decisions.choice: God says "Ta" (with the setting span) and speaks to the one who comes as "Con", capitalised, with no span
decisions.reason: As in the same quotation in Mark 1:2: the meaning decisions say God speaks and the one addressed is Jesus, whom Vietnamese can only address with a word for a relation; "Con" is a noun of address and takes no span.

decisions.choice: "Kinh Thánh đã chép" for "it is written"
decisions.reason: The impersonal "it has been written" refers to Scripture; Vietnamese names it at every level, as Luke 4:4 Balanced does, since "người mà có lời chép về" is awkward.

decisions.choice: God speaks to the coming one in 해라체 ("내", "네", "너"); "사자" (L, B), "심부름꾼" (R)
alternatives: deity_pronoun spans as in the English
decisions.reason: The words and register of Mark 1:2 in Korean, where the same text is quoted: God speaking uses 해라체, and Korean has no capital letters for the English setting to change. Literal keeps "before your face" ("네 얼굴 앞에").

decisions.choice: tu (tua, teu, ti) for the one God speaks to
decisions.reason: God speaks to the one who is to come, that is, to Jesus (m2), so Portuguese uses "tu" (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4), with the capital-pronoun setting on every form, as in Matthew 11:10.

decisions.choice: the messenger and his task in one relative clause before the verb: "... የሚያዘጋጀውን መልእክተኛዬን ... እልካለሁ"
alternatives: two clauses: "I send my messenger; he will prepare your way"
decisions.reason: Amharic puts a relative clause before its noun and the verb last, so Literal keeps the Greek's single sentence in that order, as in the parallel Matthew 11:10; Balanced and Readable use two clauses. Luke has no emphatic "I" here, so "እኔ" is not written.

source.text: λέγω ὑμῖν, μείζων ἐν γεννητοῖς γυναικῶν Ἰωάννου οὐδείς ἐστιν· ὁ δὲ μικρότερος ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ μείζων αὐτοῦ ἐστιν.

records.literal_gloss: I say to you, greater among born of women than John no one is; the but least in the kingdom of the God greater than him is.

en.L: I tell you, among those born of women no one is greater than John; but the least in the kingdom of God is greater than he."
en.B: I tell you, of all who have been born of women, there is none greater than John. Yet the least in the kingdom of God is greater than he is."
en.R: I tell you, no one who has ever been born is greater than John. But even the least important person in the kingdom of God is greater than he is."

es.L: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo: entre los nacidos de mujeres nadie es mayor que Juan; pero el más pequeño en el reino de Dios es mayor que él».
es.B: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que, de todos los que han nacido de mujer, no hay nadie mayor que Juan. Sin embargo, el más pequeño en el reino de Dios es mayor que él».
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que nadie que haya nacido jamás es más grande que Juan. Pero aun la persona menos importante en el reino de Dios es más grande que él».

fr.L: Je vous le dis, parmi ceux qui sont nés de femmes, nul n’est plus grand que Jean ; mais le plus petit dans le royaume de Dieu est plus grand que lui. »
fr.B: Je vous le dis : de tous les êtres nés d’une femme, aucun n’est plus grand que Jean. Pourtant, le plus petit dans le royaume de Dieu est plus grand que lui. »
fr.R: Je vous le dis, aucun être humain n’a jamais été plus grand que Jean. Mais même celui qui est le moins important dans le royaume de Dieu est plus grand que lui. »

sw.L: Nawaambia, miongoni mwa waliozaliwa na wanawake hakuna aliye mkuu kuliko Yohana; lakini aliye mdogo katika ufalme wa Mungu ni mkuu kuliko yeye."
sw.B: Nawaambia, kati ya wote waliozaliwa na wanawake, hakuna aliye mkuu kuliko Yohana. Hata hivyo, aliye mdogo kabisa katika ufalme wa Mungu ni mkuu kuliko yeye."
sw.R: Nawaambia, hakuna mtu aliyewahi kuzaliwa aliye mkuu kuliko Yohana. Lakini hata mtu asiye muhimu kabisa katika ufalme wa Mungu ni mkuu kuliko yeye."

vi.L: Ta nói với các người, trong những người do người nữ sinh ra, không có ai lớn hơn Giăng; nhưng người nhỏ nhất trong vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời còn lớn hơn ông ấy."
vi.B: Ta nói với các người, trong tất cả những người do phụ nữ sinh ra, không có ai lớn hơn Giăng. Thế nhưng người nhỏ nhất trong vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời còn lớn hơn ông ấy."
vi.R: Ta nói với các người, trong tất cả những người đã từng sinh ra trên đời, không có ai lớn hơn Giăng. Nhưng ngay cả người kém quan trọng nhất trong vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời cũng lớn hơn ông ấy."

ko.L: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 여자에게서 태어난 사람들 가운데 요한보다 더 큰 사람은 없다. 그러나 하나님의 나라에서 가장 작은 사람이라도 그보다 더 크다."
ko.B: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 여자에게서 태어난 사람 가운데 요한보다 더 큰 사람은 없다. 그러나 하나님의 나라에서는 가장 작은 사람이라도 요한보다 크다."
ko.R: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 지금까지 태어난 사람 가운데 요한보다 더 큰 사람은 없다. 그러나 하나님의 나라에서 가장 보잘것없는 사람이라도 요한보다 더 크다."

pt.L: Eu lhes digo: entre os nascidos de mulheres ninguém é maior que João; mas o menor no Reino de Deus é maior que ele."
pt.B: Eu lhes digo: de todos os que nasceram de mulher, não há ninguém maior do que João. Mesmo assim, o menor no Reino de Deus é maior do que ele."
pt.R: Eu digo a vocês: nunca nasceu ninguém maior do que João. Mas até a pessoa menos importante no Reino de Deus é maior do que ele."

am.L: እላችኋለሁ፤ ከሴቶች ከተወለዱት መካከል ከዮሐንስ የሚበልጥ ማንም የለም፤ በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ውስጥ ያለው ታናሹ ግን ከእርሱ ይበልጣል።»
am.B: እላችኋለሁ፤ ከሴት ከተወለዱት ሁሉ መካከል ከዮሐንስ የሚበልጥ ማንም የለም። ሆኖም በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ከሁሉ ያነሰው እንኳ ከእርሱ ይበልጣል።»
am.R: እነግራችኋለሁ፤ ከተወለዱት ሰዎች ሁሉ ከዮሐንስ የሚበልጥ የለም። ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ውስጥ ከሁሉ ያነሰ ሰው እንኳ ከዮሐንስ ይበልጣል።»

decisions.choice: among those born of women: among all human beings
alternatives: among the sons of mothers only
decisions.reason: The phrase is a Hebrew way of saying all people (Job 14:1).

decisions.choice: the least: the one of lowest rank
alternatives: the lesser one, meaning Jesus, who came after John
decisions.reason: The word is a comparative, "lesser", which here has the force of "least". Some readers in the early church took it to mean Jesus, younger than John and seen as lesser. But the contrast is between all who have lived and anyone in the kingdom of God.

decisions.choice: greater than John: not in character, but in what God has given
alternatives: John is shut out of the kingdom
decisions.reason: John stands at the turning point, the last and greatest of those who announced what was coming (16:16). To share in the kingdom that has now come with Jesus is a greater gift than even John's great task.

decisions.choice: no one who has ever been born
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means.

decisions.choice: the quotation closes here and opens again in 7:31
decisions.reason: 7:29-30 are the narrator's words, as the decision on 7:29 explains.

decisions.choice: el reino de Dios, at every level
decisions.reason: The book-wide term, the same phrase at every level, as the English has "the kingdom of God".

decisions.choice: le royaume de Dieu at every level (for the whole chapter)
decisions.reason: As the style guide sets for the New Testament. "Règne" would stress the reign over the realm; "royaume" is the familiar French term and covers both, as "kingdom" does.

decisions.choice: ufalme wa Mungu, at every level
decisions.reason: The book-wide term, the same phrase at every level, as the English has "the kingdom of God".

decisions.choice: "những người do người nữ sinh ra" (L); "do phụ nữ sinh ra" (B); "đã từng sinh ra trên đời" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the idiom means all human beings; Literal and Balanced keep it, Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት" (the kingdom of God) at every level
decisions.reason: Luke says "the kingdom of God" where Matthew 11:11 says "the kingdom of heaven"; the plain Amharic phrase is understood by every reader and is used at every level, so the two Gospels differ here as the Greek does.

source.text: καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἀκούσας καὶ οἱ τελῶναι ἐδικαίωσαν τὸν θεόν, βαπτισθέντες τὸ βάπτισμα Ἰωάννου·

records.literal_gloss: And all the people having heard and the tax collectors declared righteous the God, having been baptized [with] the baptism of John;

en.L: And all the people who heard, even the tax collectors, justified God, having been baptized with the baptism of John;
en.B: All the people who heard this, even the tax collectors, agreed that God was in the right, because they had been baptized with John's baptism.
en.R: All the people who heard Jesus say this agreed that God's way was right. Even the tax collectors agreed. They were the ones who had let John baptize them.

es.L: Y todo el pueblo, al oír[lo], y aun los publicanos, declararon justo a Dios, habiendo sido bautizados con el bautismo de Juan;
es.B: Todo el pueblo que lo oyó, incluso los cobradores de impuestos, reconoció que Dios tenía razón, porque habían sido bautizados con el bautismo de Juan.
es.R: Toda la gente que oyó a Jesús decir esto estuvo de acuerdo en que el camino de Dios era el correcto. Hasta los cobradores de impuestos estuvieron de acuerdo. Ellos eran los que se habían dejado bautizar por Juan.

fr.L: Et tout le peuple qui entendit, et même les collecteurs d’impôts, justifièrent Dieu, ayant été baptisés du baptême de Jean ;
fr.B: Tout le peuple qui l’entendit, même les collecteurs d’impôts, reconnut que Dieu était dans son droit, car ils avaient été baptisés du baptême de Jean.
fr.R: Tous les gens qui ont entendu Jésus dire cela ont reconnu que le chemin de Dieu était le bon. Les collecteurs d’impôts aussi l’ont reconnu. C’étaient eux qui s’étaient fait baptiser par Jean.

sw.L: Na watu wote waliposikia, hata watoza ushuru, walimkiri Mungu kuwa mwenye haki, wakiwa wamebatizwa kwa ubatizo wa Yohana;
sw.B: Watu wote waliosikia maneno haya, hata watoza ushuru, walikubali kwamba Mungu yuko sahihi, kwa kuwa walikuwa wamebatizwa kwa ubatizo wa Yohana.
sw.R: Watu wote waliomsikia Yesu akisema hivyo walikubali kwamba njia ya Mungu ni sahihi. Hata watoza ushuru walikubali. Wao ndio waliokuwa wamekubali kubatizwa na Yohana.

vi.L: Và cả dân chúng đã nghe, ngay cả những người thu thuế, đều xưng Đức Chúa Trời là công chính, vì đã chịu báp-têm của Giăng;
vi.B: Cả dân chúng nghe điều này, ngay cả những người thu thuế, đều nhìn nhận Đức Chúa Trời là đúng, vì họ đã chịu báp-têm của Giăng.
vi.R: Cả dân chúng nghe Đức Giê-xu nói điều này đều đồng ý rằng đường lối của Đức Chúa Trời là đúng. Ngay cả những người thu thuế cũng đồng ý. Họ là những người đã chịu để Giăng làm báp-têm cho mình.

ko.L: 그리고 [이 말씀을] 들은 모든 백성과 세리들도 하나님께서 옳으시다고 인정하였다. 그들은 요한의 세례를 받은 사람들이었다.
ko.B: 이 말씀을 들은 모든 백성은, 세리들까지도, 하나님께서 옳으시다고 인정하였다. 그들은 요한에게 세례를 받았기 때문이다.
ko.R: 예수께서 하시는 이 말씀을 들은 사람들은 모두 하나님의 뜻이 옳다고 인정하였다. 세금 걷는 사람들도 그렇게 인정하였다. 그들은 요한에게 세례를 받은 사람들이었다.

pt.L: E todo o povo que ouviu, e até os cobradores de impostos, justificaram a Deus, tendo sido batizados com o batismo de João;
pt.B: Todos os que ouviram isso, até os cobradores de impostos, reconheceram que Deus estava certo, pois tinham sido batizados com o batismo de João.
pt.R: Todas as pessoas que ouviram Jesus dizer isso concordaram que o caminho de Deus era o certo. Até os cobradores de impostos concordaram. Eles eram os que tinham deixado João batizá-los.

am.L: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ቀራጮችም ሰምተው፣ በዮሐንስ ጥምቀት የተጠመቁ ስለ ሆኑ፣ እግዚአብሔርን አጸደቁ፤
am.B: ይህን የሰሙ ሕዝብ ሁሉ፣ ቀራጮችም እንኳ፣ በዮሐንስ ጥምቀት ተጠምቀው ስለ ነበር እግዚአብሔር ትክክል መሆኑን መሰከሩ።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ይህን ሲናገር የሰሙ ሰዎች ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔር መንገድ ትክክል መሆኑን ተቀበሉ። ቀራጮችም እንኳ ተቀበሉ። እነርሱ ዮሐንስ እንዲያጠምቃቸው የፈቀዱ ነበሩ።

decisions.choice: 7:29-30 are the narrator's comment, not part of Jesus's speech
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT does not use quotation marks, but it ends Jesus's words with a full stop at 7:28 and starts a new paragraph at 7:31, where Jesus asks another question. 7:29-30 tell, in the past tense, how two groups had responded to John, which is how Luke the narrator speaks (compare 3:10-14 and 20:4-7). Some read the verses as Jesus's own words; the meaning would not change.

decisions.choice: justified God: declared that God was right
